dataset.source: UCI Machine Learning Repository, id 165 (Concrete Compressive Strength, Yeh 1998), via ucimlrepo
dataset.recipe_group: exact tuple of the seven ingredient columns (Age excluded)

partition.rule: shuffle sorted recipe ids with numpy default_rng(seed); first round(0.2 * n_recipes) are test

folds.inner: GroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed), groups = recipe id
folds.outer: GroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed), groups = recipe id
folds.optimism_check: KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed), rows shuffled, groups ignored

metric: mean absolute error (MPa), lower is better

model.loss_note: trained on squared error (the default, so residual = negative gradient); scored on MAE, the declared question from #23

search.deterministic_objective_reason: fixed folds and random_state make each trial's CV score exactly repeatable

one_knob_demo.knob: learning_rate (log scale, 0.01 to 0.5); other settings at scikit-learn defaults except early_stopping=False
one_knob_demo.folds: the inner GroupKFold on the training recipes

nested_cv: outer grouped folds around the full GPSampler search (same budget, inner grouped folds on each outer-training part); best params refit on the outer-training part and scored on its outer fold; baselines scored on the same outer folds
decision_rule: keep the tuned model as the final model only if its mean nested-CV MAE gain over default boosting (paired by outer fold) is larger than the SD of those 5 paired gains; otherwise the final model is default boosting. Decided before the test set is opened.
test_opening: exactly once, after the decision; scores median, linear, default boosting, random-search-tuned and GP-tuned boosting (each refit on all training rows) on identical test rows
named_test_errors_rule: report the test rows with the median and the maximum absolute error of the final model, with every model's prediction
